review_text: Shop attendant was super attentive and friendly!! He brought out different beans for us to smell and choose, very patiently explained all the flavours and the prep process. Pls come n try their beans!!!

At first glance it seemed like just a shop but NO…Drop by for coffee beans or just a cup. Affordable rates. Surprising menu that includes the names of growers. I tried a cup of the Finca de Garces which was good. I’m eyeing the beans next. By the way, because of the tight space you can only do short drop-ins. As with food, I didn’t see any on the menu or at the counter
love the barista! he was super friendly and amazing
